quest.title: Gold Devouring and Mora Gathering
quest.description: The day for Hatim to conduct some futures trading has arrived. What will he get from this trade?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Hm... Not bad at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like you've made a fortune...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler! Thanks to you, I've made a small profit this time. Looks like the "Golden Dish" proved effective.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: However, it's not much different from what I usually earn from normal trades...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: This is not how a "Golden Dish" should work. Did I eat the wrong dish...?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Traveler, let's try this once more. Can you please help me choose a "Golden Dish" again?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Just as always, please pick one from among <color=#00E1FFFF>Mora Meat</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Butter Chicken</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>Pile 'Em Up</color>.

talks.objective: Help Hatim select a Golden Dish

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: After the minor profit last time, I'm definitely making a killing this time! <color=#00E1FFFF>Mora Meat</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Butter Chicken</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>Pile 'Em Up</color>. How about it, then? What'll your choice be?

talks.objective: Help Hatim select a Golden Dish

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Good! A dish of excellent quality! I'm sure the futures I bought will surge this time!

talks.objective: Help Hatim select a Golden Dish

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: This looks to be of good quality. Will I be able to make a fine profit this time?

talks.objective: Help Hatim select a Golden Dish

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: This dish looks a little strange... Oh well, it matters not. Work calls me.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: I can't thank you enough, Traveler! Hope we'll meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi! Hatim, how have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Oh... It's you guys.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Well, I guess you can tell from my expression, no?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: I'll be honest, my wallet has been rendered half empty.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Strange... This isn't how things should have gone...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: But then again... I have a suspicion that this is a sign that the market's about to take off.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: It's like how people have to bend down before they can leap high.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: The same goes for the futures trading market. The entire market just fell to an all-time low and it's about to bottom out!

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: In other words, now is the best time to go bargain-hunting!

choices.text: Maybe it hasn't hit the bottom yet...

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: No. I am pretty sure this is a once-in-a-lifetime chance, and Hatim never misses any chance to gain wealth.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: That would be worthy of my name as Kalimi's exceptionally wealthy Hatim!

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Come, friend, help me out one more time, will you? Please choose another "Golden Dish"!

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Hm... Wait, no! Since we're going bargain-hunting, I need a dish that is extra special to turn the tide on the market.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: I heard that Mondstadt has a tycoon who runs a super profitable alcohol business...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But how did you know about...

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Hahaha, how could I not know of him, when I even know about "Pile 'Em Up"?

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: He owns a tavern where they sell something wonderful known as Apple Cider. If I down some of that, I believe I shall imbibe some of his affinity for wealth as well!

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: So please, help me get a bottle of Apple Cider!

choices.text: Some people get leg cramps when they bend low...

talks.objective: Help Hatim prepare an Apple Cider

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: We shall earn back what was lost, and with interest to boot!

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: This is that tycoon's apple cider, yes? Ah, what an extraordinary aroma. It truly clears the mind!

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Great! This is the good stuff indeed. It shall surely bring about a shift in the market!

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: I won't forget the help you two have given me! I'll see you around!
